name: executePlan
description: Executes a pre-defined test plan containing multiple steps (click, sendKeys, wait, screenshot) in batch mode. Ideal for known test flows and regression testing. The plan runs asynchronously and returns a traceId immediately for tracking execution status. Use this when you have a complete test sequence ready; for exploratory testing where you need to see results before deciding next steps, use the interactive element operations instead (findElement, clickElement, etc.).

plan.description: Test plan containing an array of sequential steps to execute

selector.description: Element locator using XPath or other strategy (required for click, sendKeys)

params.description: Additional parameters specific to the step type (e.g., {text: 'hello'} for sendKeys, {duration: 2000} for wait)

traceId.description: Optional trace ID for correlating this execution with logs and artifacts. Auto-generated if not provided
